name: Fireworks AI
tagline: Fast inference and fine-tuning for open models, billed by use
description: Fireworks AI runs open models through a serverless API and dedicated GPU deployments, and offers managed fine-tuning, with usage-based billing.
features: On-demand GPU deployments priced per GPU second
Fine-tuned models served at the same price as base models
useCases: Running open models behind an API
Fine-tuning an open model on your own data
strengths: Pay-per-token serverless pricing with spend limits and auto reload
Compliance certifications listed (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001)
limitations: A general free tier or free credits are not stated
Region-restricted deployments are priced at a 1.5x premium

plans.name: Serverless inference
plans.note: Pre-paid, usage-based billing per token (output, input and cached tokens); auto reload and monthly spend limits are available. Embeddings: $0.008 per 1M input tokens up to 150M-parameter models

plans.name: On-demand GPUs
plans.note: Per GPU second with no extra charge for start-up. Examples: H100 80 GB $8.00 per hour; B200 180 GB $13.00 per hour; GB300 288 GB $20.00 per hour

plans.name: Managed fine-tuning
plans.note: Per 1M training tokens. Examples for base models up to 16B: LoRA SFT $0.50, LoRA DPO $1.00, full-parameter SFT $1.00, full-parameter DPO $2.00

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Contact sales for faster speeds, lower costs and higher rate limits

pricing.regional: Prices were shown with a '$' sign; the page does not state 'USD'. Free credits: not stated. SLAs, contract length and refund terms: not stated.

verification.notes: Product active (inference, training and on-demand GPU deployments). Pre-paid, usage-based pricing per token / per GPU second / per 1M training tokens; enterprise by contact. Embeddings from $0.008 per 1M input tokens. Per-model serverless rates are in the separate pricing docs and were not recorded. No standing free credit is stated; a time-limited free training offer ends 11/30.
